en.title: AI Act, Annex X: the quoted title of the Eurodac Regulation names Regulation (EU) 2024/1315 instead of 2024/1351
en.summary: The title of Regulation (EU) 2024/1358 as published names Regulations (EU) 2024/1351 and (EU) 2024/1350. English and 22 other versions of Annex X have 2024/1315; the Finnish version has 2024/1351. The main reference to Regulation (EU) 2024/1358 is correct. The Spanish corrigendum of 4.5.2026 (OJ L, 2026/90343) restates Annex X, point 3, and keeps 2024/1315.
en.impact: No change to which systems are listed; the quoted title names a different regulation.
en.correction: Replace 2024/1315 with 2024/1351 in the quoted title in Annex X, point 3.
